summary: Skratch discusses the Dragon Crown Homage event, expressing strong frustration with how the prize coffers and Dark Lady physical figurine rewards were designed and timed. He criticizes the limited supply of S-tier rewards, which resulted in players sniping them in the first minute of daily resets, as well as the late addition of Legendary Hero Collection Chests after many players had already spent their vouchers. He highlights an official Discord poll asking whether the developers should order more Dark Lady figurines despite a 5 to 6 month production delay. He encourages players to vote in the poll and share their feedback on the event structure.
tips: Participate in the official Dragonheir Discord poll to vote on bringing back more Dark Lady physical figurines.
When making top-up purchases on BuffBuff, re-click creator referral links to ensure support points are correctly applied.
title: This Is Ridiculous! More Dark Lady Figurines... Dragonheir: Silent Gods x Dragonstride
